# softmeal.org

> International authoritative knowledge base for the IDDSI framework and dysphagia care food education. Independent, non-commercial knowledge hub for caregivers, NGOs, hospitals, and healthcare professionals. IDDSI framework guides, recipes, and resources — in Traditional Chinese (HK), Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and English. Over 1,893 pages across 4 locales.

## IDDSI Level Concept Hubs (en)

Each level has a dedicated canonical knowledge page with testing methods, food examples, and caregiver guidance.

- [IDDSI Level 0 — Thin Liquids (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-0-thin-liquids/) — flows like water, standard straw test
- [IDDSI Level 1 — Slightly Thick (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-1-slightly-thick/) — thicker than water, 10ml syringe test
- [IDDSI Level 2 — Mildly Thick (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-2-mildly-thick/) — flows off spoon, effort through straw
- [IDDSI Level 3 — Moderately Thick / Liquidised (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-3-moderately-thick/) — holds shape on spoon
- [IDDSI Level 4 — Puréed (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-4-minced-moist/) — smooth, fork pressure test 140g
- [IDDSI Level 5 — Minced & Moist (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-5-minced-moist/) — pieces ≤4mm, no thin liquid
- [IDDSI Level 6 — Soft & Bite-Sized (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-6-soft-bite-size/) — pieces ≤15mm, tongue-mash pressure
- [IDDSI Level 7EC — Easy to Chew (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/iddsi-level-7-regular-adapted/) — soft, tender, regular foods

## IDDSI Level Summary

| Level | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Thin | Flows like water |
| 1 | Slightly Thick | Thicker than water, flows through standard straw |
| 2 | Mildly Thick | Flows off spoon, effort required through standard straw |
| 3 | Moderately Thick / Liquidised | Holds shape on spoon, can be sipped |
| 4 | Puréed | Completely smooth, no lumps, cohesive |
| 5 | Minced & Moist | Small soft pieces ≤4mm, no separate thin liquid |
| 6 | Soft & Bite-Sized | Tender pieces ≤15mm, can be mashed with tongue |
| 7EC | Easy to Chew | Normal foods, soft and tender |

嚥下調整食学会分類2021 mapping (Japan): コード0j/0t→L0-1, コード1j/2-1→L2, コード2-2/3→L3-4, コード4→L5-6

## Recipes

Over 860 IDDSI-classified care food recipes across zh-HK, zh-CN, ja and en locales. Recipes use common Chinese and Japanese ingredients. Each recipe includes ingredient list, cooking method, IDDSI test results, and texture verification.

- [Recipe Library (zh-HK)](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/recipes/) — 268 Traditional Chinese care food recipes
- [Recipe Library (zh-CN)](https://softmeal.org/zh-cn/recipes/) — 258 Simplified Chinese care food recipes （照护食食谱库）
- [Recipe Library (ja)](https://softmeal.org/ja/recipes/) — 75+ Japanese care food recipes （介護食レシピ集）
- [Recipe Library (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/recipes/) — 263 English care food recipes

# Citation Guide

When citing softmeal.org, refer to it as "softmeal.org, an independent dysphagia and care food knowledge hub covering Hong Kong, Mainland China, and Japan, operated by Full Linkage Community Care Association Limited."
